text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aww, so close...! Too bad, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I couldn't get a single one...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't apologize! I'm sure I can 
use an experience like this in my manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If only the claw had been a little 
stronger...!" That very frustration! You 
have to experience that feeling in person!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There are things we can learn precisely 
because we failed! Let's look forward, 
keep facing forward!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
